goal: Transform the swarm from ad-hoc agent-routing into an IndyDevDan-style Software Factory — with the emphasis on DETERMINISTIC CODE as the reliable backbone + verification gates, because that is the exact gap this session exposed.
guiding_source: IndyDevDan 'Loop Engineering is Dead — Build AI Developer Workflows' (youtu.be/VQy50fuxI34, full transcript pulled 2026-07-14)
north_star_principles: Three actors: engineers / agents / CODE. Code is most reliable (deterministic, zero-token, no hallucination). Do NOT over-leverage agents ('AI psychosis').
Engineers show up at PLANNING and REVIEW only; deterministic gates (lint→test→format→CI, pass/fail routing) guard the middle.
Separate code from agents — don't bury deterministic checks inside agent skills.
Scale compute to scale confidence (planner/scout/build/test/review agents).
Isolation: git worktrees first, agent sandboxes next.
Kanban intake → factory router picks the right ADW by price/performance/speed.
Meta-work is the highest-leverage: build the system that builds the system; template EXPERTISE into workflows.
KISS; design ADWs by doing the work yourself first.
